SECTION 3 - PERSONAL DATA WE COLLECT



The Service may collect and process various categories of personal data in connection with the operation of the Service and the provision of digital services to Users.



3.1 Account Information



When a User creates an account, the Service may collect certain information necessary to establish and manage the User's Account.



This may include:



email address



name and surname



date of birth



gender



language preferences



profile avatar (optional)



Certain information may be optional and provided voluntarily by the User.



Where the User chooses to provide such optional information, the User acknowledges that the Provider may process that information in accordance with this Privacy Policy and applicable data protection laws.



3.2 Authentication Data



In order to enable secure authentication and account management, the Service may process certain technical identifiers associated with a User account.



These identifiers may include:



internal account identifiers



authentication identifiers generated by identity providers



identifiers associated with third-party authentication services (such as Google)



These identifiers are used solely for authentication, account management, and maintaining the security and integrity of the Service.



3.3 Payment Information



Payments for Guides are processed through third-party payment processors.



The Service does not store full payment card details.



However, the Service may store limited transaction-related information, including:



purchase history



transaction status



payment amount



payment timestamps



identifiers associated with the payment processor.



Such information is used for transaction management, accounting, fraud prevention, and dispute resolution.



3.4 Technical Data and Logs



The Service may collect certain technical information necessary to ensure the security, functionality, and performance of the platform.



This may include:



IP address



approximate location derived from IP



browser and user-agent information



operating system information



device information



login timestamps and authentication events



records of user interaction with the Service interface.



Login-related logs may be retained for up to one (1) year, while certain interaction logs may be retained for shorter operational periods where necessary for operational or security purposes.



3.5 Analytics and Usage Data



The Service may collect aggregated and technical usage data in order to understand how Users interact with the platform and to improve the functionality and performance of the Service.



This may include information related to:



page views



navigation within the Service



interactions with platform features



technical performance data.



Such information may be collected through analytics technologies, including cookies and similar tracking technologies, as described in this Privacy Policy.



SECTION 4 - LEGAL BASIS FOR PROCESSING



The Provider processes personal data only where there is a lawful basis for doing so under applicable data protection laws.



The legal bases for processing personal data may include the following.



4.1 Performance of a Contract



Personal data may be processed where such processing is necessary for the performance of a contract with the User or in order to take steps at the request of the User prior to entering into a contract.



This includes situations where processing is required to provide access to the Service and to deliver digital services requested by the User.



4.2 Legitimate Interests



The Provider may process personal data where such processing is necessary for the legitimate interests pursued by the Provider, provided that such interests are not overridden by the rights and freedoms of Users.



Such legitimate interests may include maintaining the security, stability, and integrity of the Service and improving its functionality.



4.3 Legal Obligations



The Provider may process personal data where such processing is necessary to comply with legal obligations to which the Provider is subject.



This may include obligations relating to financial reporting, accounting, taxation, or compliance with regulatory authorities.



4.4 Consent



Where required by applicable law, the Provider may rely on the User's consent to process certain categories of personal data.



This may include the use of certain analytics or advertising technologies that require the User's consent under applicable data protection or electronic communications laws.



Users may withdraw their consent at any time.



SECTION 5 - PURPOSES OF PROCESSING



The Provider processes personal data for specific and legitimate purposes related to the operation of the Service.



Personal data may be processed for the following purposes.



5.1 Provision and Operation of the Service



Personal data may be processed in order to operate the Service and provide digital services to Users.



This includes enabling access to the platform and maintaining the functionality of the Service.



5.2 Account Management



Personal data may be processed in order to create, maintain, and manage User accounts and authentication systems associated with the Service.



5.3 Transaction Management



Personal data may be processed in connection with purchases made through the Service, including maintaining transaction records and managing billing-related matters.



5.4 Security and Fraud Prevention



Certain technical and operational data may be processed in order to ensure the security of the Service, detect unauthorized activity, and prevent fraud or abuse.



5.5 Service Improvement



Technical and usage data may be used to analyse system performance and improve the functionality, usability, and reliability of the Service.



5.6 Customer Support



Personal data may be processed in order to respond to User inquiries, provide assistance, and resolve technical or service-related issues.



5.7 Legal Compliance



Personal data may be processed where necessary in order to comply with applicable legal obligations or to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.



SECTION 6 - DATA RETENTION



The Provider retains personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which the data was collected, including for the purposes of providing the Service, complying with legal obligations, resolving disputes, and enforcing agreements.



Retention periods may vary depending on the category of data and the purpose of processing.



6.1 Account Data



Personal data associated with a User Account may be retained for as long as the User maintains an active account within the Service.



If a User deletes their account, the Provider will delete or anonymize personal data associated with the account, unless retention of certain data is required for legal, accounting, security, or fraud-prevention purposes.



6.2 Transaction Data



Information related to purchases and transactions may be retained for longer periods where required for:



accounting and financial reporting



tax compliance



fraud prevention



dispute resolution.



Such information may include purchase history, transaction identifiers, payment amounts, and transaction timestamps.



6.3 Authentication and Security Logs



The Service may retain certain technical logs related to authentication and security.



Login-related logs may be retained for up to one (1) year for security monitoring, fraud detection, and incident investigation.



6.4 Interaction Logs



Certain logs related to user interaction with the Service interface may be retained for operational and diagnostic purposes.



Such interaction logs may be retained for up to ninety (90) days, after which they may be deleted or anonymized.



6.5 Legal Retention Requirements



The Provider may retain certain information for longer periods where required to comply with legal obligations or where necessary to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.

SECTION 8 - INTERNATIONAL DATA TRANSFERS



The Service may involve the transfer of personal data to service providers located outside the European Economic Area (EEA).

Where required under applicable data protection laws, transfers of personal data outside the EEA will be carried out using appropriate safeguards.



Such safeguards may include:

other legally recognised transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.



8.2 Transfers to Service Providers



Certain third-party service providers used by the Service may process personal data in countries outside the EEA.

SECTION 9 - USER RIGHTS



Under applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Users may have certain rights in relation to their personal data.



These rights may include the following.



9.1 Right of Access



Users have the right to request confirmation as to whether the Provider processes their personal data.



Where personal data is being processed, Users may request access to that personal data and obtain certain information regarding the processing.



9.2 Right to Rectification



Users have the right to request the correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data held by the Provider.



Where possible, Users may also update certain personal data directly through their account settings.



9.3 Right to Erasure



Users may have the right to request the deletion of their personal data in certain circumstances.



This right may apply, for example, where personal data is no longer necessary for the purposes for which it was collected.



However, the Provider may retain certain information where retention is required to comply with legal obligations or to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.



9.4 Right to Restrict Processing



Users may request that the processing of their personal data be restricted in certain circumstances, for example where the accuracy of the data is contested.



9.5 Right to Data Portability



Where applicable, Users may request to receive personal data that they have provided to the Provider in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.



Users may also request that such data be transmitted to another data controller where technically feasible.



9.6 Right to Object



Users may object to the processing of their personal data where such processing is based on the Provider's legitimate interests.



In such cases, the Provider will cease processing the personal data unless compelling legitimate grounds exist.



9.7 Right to Withdraw Consent



Where the processing of personal data is based on the User's consent, the User has the right to withdraw that consent at any time.



Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out prior to such withdrawal.



9.8 Right to Lodge a Complaint



Users have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection authority if they believe that their personal data has been processed in violation of applicable data protection laws.



Users are encouraged to contact the Provider first so that the issue may be addressed directly where possible.



SECTION 10 - COOKIES AND TRACKING TECHNOLOGIES



The Service may use cookies and similar tracking technologies in order to ensure the proper functioning of the platform, improve the performance of the Service, and analyse how Users interact with the Service.



Cookies are small text files that are stored on a User's device when the User accesses a website or online service.



10.1 Essential Cookies



Certain cookies are necessary for the operation of the Service and cannot be disabled.



These cookies enable core functionality of the Service, including authentication, session management, and security.



Such cookies may include cookies used for:



user authentication and session management



maintaining login sessions



security mechanisms and protection against automated abuse.



These cookies are necessary for the functioning of the Service and are used on the basis of the Provider's legitimate interests in operating and securing the Service.



10.2 Security Technologies



The Service may use security technologies designed to prevent automated abuse, malicious activity, and unauthorized access.



Such technologies may include services designed to distinguish between human users and automated systems.



These security measures are necessary to protect the integrity and security of the Service.



10.3 Analytics Cookies



The Service may use analytics technologies to understand how Users interact with the Service and to improve its functionality and performance.



These technologies may collect information such as:



pages visited within the Service



interactions with platform features



technical performance data.



Where required by applicable law, non-essential cookies will be used only after the User has provided consent through the cookie consent mechanism available on the Service.



10.4 Advertising and Marketing Technologies



The Service may use certain technologies to measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns and to display relevant advertising.



Such technologies may collect information about interactions with advertisements or marketing content.



Where required by applicable law, such technologies will be used only with the User's consent.



10.5 Managing Cookie Preferences



Users may withdraw or modify their cookie preferences at any time through the cookie settings available within the Service.



Where consent is required for the use of certain cookies, Users may accept or decline such cookies.



Users may also configure their browser settings to block or delete cookies. However, disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the Service.



SECTION 11 - DATA SECURITY



The Provider implements appropriate technical and organisational measures designed to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.



Such measures may include, where appropriate:



secure authentication mechanisms



access controls and internal authorization procedures



encryption and secure data transmission technologies



monitoring and logging of security-related events



protection against automated abuse and malicious activity.



The Provider takes reasonable steps to ensure that personal data processed through the Service is protected in accordance with applicable data protection laws.



However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is completely secure, and the Provider cannot guarantee absolute security of personal data.



SECTION 12 - CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY



The Provider may update or modify this Privacy Policy from time to time in order to reflect changes in the Service, legal requirements, or data processing practices.



Where material changes are made, the Provider may notify Users through the Service or by other appropriate means.
